name: Sledless Power March

instructions.description: Loop a resistance band around your waist and anchor it securely behind you.
Lean slightly forward from the ankles and begin marching forward against the band tension.
Drive each knee up with force while keeping the trunk stiff and the steps deliberate.
Walk back carefully to release tension and rest before the next bout.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use short resisted intervals with complete control.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform the same march pattern without band tension.

commentsNotes: Check the band anchor before starting.
Do not let the band pull you backward suddenly.
